--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cli/cli-commands/coder/ensureCoderGitattributesFile.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import { ensureProjectTextFile } from '../common/ensureProjectTextFile';
+import type { InitializationStatus } from './boilerplateTemplates';
+
+/**
+ * Project-relative path to the Git attributes initialized by Promptbook Coder.
+ *
+ * @private internal constant of `coder init`
+ */
+export const CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH = '.gitattributes';
+
+/**
+ * Default Git attributes for automatic text detection and consistent LF line endings.
+ */
+const DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT = '* text=auto eol=lf';
+
+/**
+ * Creates default Git attributes when missing, preserving project-owned attributes.
+ *
+ * @private function of `initializeCoderProjectConfiguration`
+ */
+export async function ensureCoderGitattributesFile(projectPath: string): Promise<InitializationStatus> {
+    return ensureProjectTextFile(projectPath, CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH, DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT);
+}
+
+// Note: [🟡] Code for coder init Git attributes bootstrapping [ensureCoderGitattributesFile](src/cli/cli-commands/coder/ensureCoderGitattributesFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`

diff --git a/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f2adc567934c05453e76e15530fd1e8fc02fa44c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { stat, writeFile } from 'fs/promises';
+import { join } from 'path';
+import type { ProjectInitializationStatus } from './projectInitialization';
+
+/**
+ * Creates one project text file with default content, preserving any existing file.
+ *
+ * @private internal utility of Promptbook CLI project initialization
+ */
+export async function ensureProjectTextFile(
+    projectPath: string,
+    relativeFilePath: string,
+    fileContent: string,
+): Promise<ProjectInitializationStatus> {
+    const absoluteFilePath = join(projectPath, relativeFilePath);
+    if (await isExistingFile(absoluteFilePath)) {
+        return 'unchanged';
+    }
+
+    await writeFile(absoluteFilePath, `${fileContent}\n`, 'utf-8');
+    return 'created';
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a path exists and is a file.
+ */
+async function isExistingFile(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+        return (await stat(path)).isFile();
+    } catch {
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+// Note: [🟡] Code for project text file bootstrapping [ensureProjectTextFile](src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`

 #### What each command does
 
 | Command                               | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
 | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --- | ------ | ---- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
-| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `/.promptbook`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
+| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `node_modules` and `/.promptbook`; creates missing `.gitattributes` with `* text=auto eol=lf`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
 | `ptbk coder generate-boilerplates`    | Creates new prompt markdown files with fresh emoji tags so you can quickly fill in coding tasks; `--template` accepts either a built-in alias or a markdown file path relative to the project root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
 | `ptbk coder run`                      | Picks the next ready prompt, can run project checks before coding to stop or repair pre-existing failures, appends optional context, runs it through the selected coding agent, can optionally check each attempt with the project command and feed failing output back for retries, then marks success or failure, commits the result, and pushes only when `--auto-push` is enabled.                                                                                      |
 | `ptbk coder find-refactor-candidates` | Scans the repository for oversized or overpacked files and writes prompt files for likely refactors; `--level <xlow                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | low | medium | high | xhigh | extreme>` ranges from a very benevolent scan to a very aggressive sweep. |

@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import { ensureProjectTextFile } from '../common/ensureProjectTextFile';
+import type { InitializationStatus } from './boilerplateTemplates';
+
+/**
+ * Project-relative path to the Git attributes initialized by Promptbook Coder.
+ *
+ * @private internal constant of `coder init`
+ */
+export const CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH = '.gitattributes';
+
+/**
+ * Default Git attributes for automatic text detection and consistent LF line endings.
+ */
+const DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT = '* text=auto eol=lf';
+
+/**
+ * Creates default Git attributes when missing, preserving project-owned attributes.
+ *
+ * @private function of `initializeCoderProjectConfiguration`
+ */
+export async function ensureCoderGitattributesFile(projectPath: string): Promise<InitializationStatus> {
+    return ensureProjectTextFile(projectPath, CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH, DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT);
+}
+
+// Note: [🟡] Code for coder init Git attributes bootstrapping [ensureCoderGitattributesFile](src/cli/cli-commands/coder/ensureCoderGitattributesFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`

+import { stat, writeFile } from 'fs/promises';
+import { join } from 'path';
+import type { ProjectInitializationStatus } from './projectInitialization';
+
+/**
+ * Creates one project text file with default content, preserving any existing file.
+ *
+ * @private internal utility of Promptbook CLI project initialization
+ */
+export async function ensureProjectTextFile(
+    projectPath: string,
+    relativeFilePath: string,
+    fileContent: string,
+): Promise<ProjectInitializationStatus> {
+    const absoluteFilePath = join(projectPath, relativeFilePath);
+    if (await isExistingFile(absoluteFilePath)) {
+        return 'unchanged';
+    }
+
+    await writeFile(absoluteFilePath, `${fileContent}\n`, 'utf-8');
+    return 'created';
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a path exists and is a file.
+ */
+async function isExistingFile(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+        return (await stat(path)).isFile();
+    } catch {
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+// Note: [🟡] Code for project text file bootstrapping [ensureProjectTextFile](src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`

import { stat, writeFile } from 'fs/promises';
import { join } from 'path';
import type { ProjectInitializationStatus } from './projectInitialization';

/**
 * Creates one project text file with default content, preserving any existing file.
 *
 * @private internal utility of Promptbook CLI project initialization
 */
export async function ensureProjectTextFile(
    projectPath: string,
    relativeFilePath: string,
    fileContent: string,
): Promise<ProjectInitializationStatus> {
    const absoluteFilePath = join(projectPath, relativeFilePath);
    if (await isExistingFile(absoluteFilePath)) {
        return 'unchanged';
    }

    await writeFile(absoluteFilePath, `${fileContent}\n`, 'utf-8');
    return 'created';
}

/**
 * Checks whether a path exists and is a file.
 */
async function isExistingFile(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
        return (await stat(path)).isFile();
    } catch {
        return false;
    }
}

// Note: [🟡] Code for project text file bootstrapping [ensureProjectTextFile](src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`
import { ensureProjectTextFile } from '../common/ensureProjectTextFile';
import type { InitializationStatus } from './boilerplateTemplates';

/**
 * Project-relative path to the Git attributes initialized by Promptbook Coder.
 *
 * @private internal constant of `coder init`
 */
export const CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH = '.gitattributes';

/**
 * Default Git attributes for automatic text detection and consistent LF line endings.
 */
const DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT = '* text=auto eol=lf';

/**
 * Creates default Git attributes when missing, preserving project-owned attributes.
 *
 * @private function of `initializeCoderProjectConfiguration`
 */
export async function ensureCoderGitattributesFile(projectPath: string): Promise<InitializationStatus> {
    return ensureProjectTextFile(projectPath, CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH, DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT);
}

+ * Project-relative path to the Git attributes initialized by Promptbook Coder.

+export const CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH = '.gitattributes';
+
+/**
+ * Default Git attributes for automatic text detection and consistent LF line endings.
+ */
+const DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT = '* text=auto eol=lf';

+/**
+ * Creates default Git attributes when missing, preserving project-owned attributes.
+ *
+ * @private function of `initializeCoderProjectConfiguration`

+export async function ensureCoderGitattributesFile(projectPath: string): Promise<InitializationStatus> {

diff --git a/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f2adc567934c05453e76e15530fd1e8fc02fa44c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { stat, writeFile } from 'fs/promises';
+import { join } from 'path';
+import type { ProjectInitializationStatus } from './projectInitialization';
+
+/**
+ * Creates one project text file with default content, preserving any existing file.
+ *
+ * @private internal utility of Promptbook CLI project initialization
+ */
+export async function ensureProjectTextFile(
+    projectPath: string,
+    relativeFilePath: string,
+    fileContent: string,
+): Promise<ProjectInitializationStatus> {
+    const absoluteFilePath = join(projectPath, relativeFilePath);
+    if (await isExistingFile(absoluteFilePath)) {
+        return 'unchanged';
+    }
+
+    await writeFile(absoluteFilePath, `${fileContent}\n`, 'utf-8');
+    return 'created';
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a path exists and is a file.
+ */
+async function isExistingFile(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+        return (await stat(path)).isFile();
+    } catch {
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+// Note: [🟡] Code for project text file bootstrapping [ensureProjectTextFile](src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`

 #### What each command does
 
 | Command                               | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
 | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --- | ------ | ---- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
-| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `/.promptbook`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
+| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `node_modules` and `/.promptbook`; creates missing `.gitattributes` with `* text=auto eol=lf`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
 | `ptbk coder generate-boilerplates`    | Creates new prompt markdown files with fresh emoji tags so you can quickly fill in coding tasks; `--template` accepts either a built-in alias or a markdown file path relative to the project root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
 | `ptbk coder run`                      | Picks the next ready prompt, can run project checks before coding to stop or repair pre-existing failures, appends optional context, runs it through the selected coding agent, can optionally check each attempt with the project command and feed failing output back for retries, then marks success or failure, commits the result, and pushes only when `--auto-push` is enabled.                                                                                      |
 | `ptbk coder find-refactor-candidates` | Scans the repository for oversized or overpacked files and writes prompt files for likely refactors; `--level <xlow                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | low | medium | high | xhigh | extreme>` ranges from a very benevolent scan to a very aggressive sweep. |

+import { ensureProjectTextFile } from '../common/ensureProjectTextFile';
+import type { InitializationStatus } from './boilerplateTemplates';
+
+/**
+ * Project-relative path to the Git attributes initialized by Promptbook Coder.
+ *
+ * @private internal constant of `coder init`
+ */
+export const CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH = '.gitattributes';
+
+/**
+ * Default Git attributes for automatic text detection and consistent LF line endings.
+ */
+const DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT = '* text=auto eol=lf';
+
+/**
+ * Creates default Git attributes when missing, preserving project-owned attributes.
+ *
+ * @private function of `initializeCoderProjectConfiguration`
+ */
+export async function ensureCoderGitattributesFile(projectPath: string): Promise<InitializationStatus> {
+    return ensureProjectTextFile(projectPath, CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH, DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT);
+}

diff --git a/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f2adc567934c05453e76e15530fd1e8fc02fa44c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { stat, writeFile } from 'fs/promises';
+import { join } from 'path';
+import type { ProjectInitializationStatus } from './projectInitialization';
+
+/**
+ * Creates one project text file with default content, preserving any existing file.
+ *
+ * @private internal utility of Promptbook CLI project initialization
+ */
+export async function ensureProjectTextFile(
+    projectPath: string,
+    relativeFilePath: string,
+    fileContent: string,
+): Promise<ProjectInitializationStatus> {
+    const absoluteFilePath = join(projectPath, relativeFilePath);
+    if (await isExistingFile(absoluteFilePath)) {
+        return 'unchanged';
+    }
+
+    await writeFile(absoluteFilePath, `${fileContent}\n`, 'utf-8');
+    return 'created';
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a path exists and is a file.
+ */
+async function isExistingFile(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+        return (await stat(path)).isFile();
+    } catch {
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+// Note: [🟡] Code for project text file bootstrapping [ensureProjectTextFile](src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`

 2. `ptbk coder generate-boilerplates` creates prompt files in `prompts/`.
 3. You replace placeholder `@@@` sections with real coding tasks.
 4. `ptbk coder run` sends the next ready `[ ]` prompt to the selected coding agent and immediately marks it as in progress `[^]`, naming the harness, the model and the step which is running.

+`ptbk coder init` also bootstraps a starter `AGENTS.md`, adds `package.json` scripts for the four main coder commands, adds `node_modules` and the shared `/.promptbook` temp ignore to `.gitignore`, and configures `.vscode/settings.json` so pasted images from `prompts/*.md` land in `prompts/screenshots/`. It creates a missing `.gitattributes` with `* text=auto eol=lf` and preserves existing attributes.
 
 #### What each command does
 
 | Command                               | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
 | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --- | ------ | ---- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
-| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `/.promptbook`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
+| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `node_modules` and `/.promptbook`; creates missing `.gitattributes` with `* text=auto eol=lf`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
 | `ptbk coder generate-boilerplates`    | Creates new prompt markdown files with fresh emoji tags so you can quickly fill in coding tasks; `--template` accepts either a built-in alias or a markdown file path relative to the project root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
 | `ptbk coder run`                      | Picks the next ready prompt, can run project checks before coding to stop or repair pre-existing failures, appends optional context, runs it through the selected coding agent, can optionally check each attempt with the project command and feed failing output back for retries, then marks success or failure, commits the result, and pushes only when `--auto-push` is enabled.                                                                                      |
 | `ptbk coder find-refactor-candidates` | Scans the repository for oversized or overpacked files and writes prompt files for likely refactors; `--level <xlow                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | low | medium | high | xhigh | extreme>` ranges from a very benevolent scan to a very aggressive sweep. |

+ * Project-relative path to the Git attributes initialized by Promptbook Coder.

+ * @private internal constant of `coder init`
+ */
+export const CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH = '.gitattributes';
+
+/**
+ * Default Git attributes for automatic text detection and consistent LF line endings.
+ */
+const DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT = '* text=auto eol=lf';
+
+/**
+ * Creates default Git attributes when missing, preserving project-owned attributes.
+ *
+ * @private function of `initializeCoderProjectConfiguration`

+export async function ensureCoderGitattributesFile(projectPath: string): Promise<InitializationStatus> {
+    return ensureProjectTextFile(projectPath, CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH, DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT);
+}

diff --git a/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f2adc567934c05453e76e15530fd1e8fc02fa44c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { stat, writeFile } from 'fs/promises';
+import { join } from 'path';
+import type { ProjectInitializationStatus } from './projectInitialization';
+
+/**
+ * Creates one project text file with default content, preserving any existing file.
+ *
+ * @private internal utility of Promptbook CLI project initialization
+ */
+export async function ensureProjectTextFile(
+    projectPath: string,
+    relativeFilePath: string,
+    fileContent: string,
+): Promise<ProjectInitializationStatus> {
+    const absoluteFilePath = join(projectPath, relativeFilePath);
+    if (await isExistingFile(absoluteFilePath)) {
+        return 'unchanged';
+    }
+
+    await writeFile(absoluteFilePath, `${fileContent}\n`, 'utf-8');
+    return 'created';
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a path exists and is a file.
+ */
+async function isExistingFile(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+        return (await stat(path)).isFile();
+    } catch {
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+// Note: [🟡] Code for project text file bootstrapping [ensureProjectTextFile](src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`

 | Command                               | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
 | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --- | ------ | ---- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
-| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `/.promptbook`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
+| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `node_modules` and `/.promptbook`; creates missing `.gitattributes` with `* text=auto eol=lf`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
 | `ptbk coder generate-boilerplates`    | Creates new prompt markdown files with fresh emoji tags so you can quickly fill in coding tasks; `--template` accepts either a built-in alias or a markdown file path relative to the project root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
 | `ptbk coder run`                      | Picks the next ready prompt, can run project checks before coding to stop or repair pre-existing failures, appends optional context, runs it through the selected coding agent, can optionally check each attempt with the project command and feed failing output back for retries, then marks success or failure, commits the result, and pushes only when `--auto-push` is enabled.                                                                                      |
 | `ptbk coder find-refactor-candidates` | Scans the repository for oversized or overpacked files and writes prompt files for likely refactors; `--level <xlow                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | low | medium | high | xhigh | extreme>` ranges from a very benevolent scan to a very aggressive sweep. |

diff --git a/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f2adc567934c05453e76e15530fd1e8fc02fa44c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { stat, writeFile } from 'fs/promises';
+import { join } from 'path';
+import type { ProjectInitializationStatus } from './projectInitialization';
+
+/**
+ * Creates one project text file with default content, preserving any existing file.
+ *
+ * @private internal utility of Promptbook CLI project initialization
+ */
+export async function ensureProjectTextFile(
+    projectPath: string,
+    relativeFilePath: string,
+    fileContent: string,
+): Promise<ProjectInitializationStatus> {
+    const absoluteFilePath = join(projectPath, relativeFilePath);
+    if (await isExistingFile(absoluteFilePath)) {
+        return 'unchanged';
+    }
+
+    await writeFile(absoluteFilePath, `${fileContent}\n`, 'utf-8');
+    return 'created';
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a path exists and is a file.
+ */
+async function isExistingFile(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+        return (await stat(path)).isFile();
+    } catch {
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+// Note: [🟡] Code for project text file bootstrapping [ensureProjectTextFile](src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`

-1. `ptbk coder init` prepares the project for the coder workflow, seeds project-owned generic templates in `prompts/templates/`, creates a starter `AGENTS.md` context file, adds helper `npm run coder:*` scripts, ensures `.gitignore` ignores `/.promptbook`, and configures VS Code prompt screenshots in `prompts/screenshots/`.

 2. `ptbk coder generate-boilerplates` creates prompt files in `prompts/`.
 3. You replace placeholder `@@@` sections with real coding tasks.

-`ptbk coder init` also bootstraps a starter `AGENTS.md`, adds `package.json` scripts for the four main coder commands, adds the shared `/.promptbook` temp ignore to `.gitignore`, and configures `.vscode/settings.json` so pasted images from `prompts/*.md` land in `prompts/screenshots/`.
+`ptbk coder init` also bootstraps a starter `AGENTS.md`, adds `package.json` scripts for the four main coder commands, adds `node_modules` and the shared `/.promptbook` temp ignore to `.gitignore`, and configures `.vscode/settings.json` so pasted images from `prompts/*.md` land in `prompts/screenshots/`. It creates a missing `.gitattributes` with `* text=auto eol=lf` and preserves existing attributes.
 
 #### What each command does
 
 | Command                               | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
 | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --- | ------ | ---- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
-| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `/.promptbook`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
+| `ptbk coder init`                     | Creates `prompts/`, `prompts/done/`, the project-generic template files materialized in `prompts/templates/` (currently `common.md`), and a starter `AGENTS.md`; ensures `.env` contains `CODING_AGENT_GIT_NAME`, `CODING_AGENT_GIT_EMAIL`, and `CODING_AGENT_GIT_SIGNING_KEY`; adds helper coder scripts to `package.json`; ensures `.gitignore` contains `node_modules` and `/.promptbook`; creates missing `.gitattributes` with `* text=auto eol=lf`; and configures `.vscode/settings.json` to save pasted prompt images into `prompts/screenshots/`. |
 | `ptbk coder generate-boilerplates`    | Creates new prompt markdown files with fresh emoji tags so you can quickly fill in coding tasks; `--template` accepts either a built-in alias or a markdown file path relative to the project root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
 | `ptbk coder run`                      | Picks the next ready prompt, can run project checks before coding to stop or repair pre-existing failures, appends optional context, runs it through the selected coding agent, can optionally check each attempt with the project command and feed failing output back for retries, then marks success or failure, commits the result, and pushes only when `--auto-push` is enabled.                                                                                      |
 | `ptbk coder find-refactor-candidates` | Scans the repository for oversized or overpacked files and writes prompt files for likely refactors; `--level <xlow                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | low | medium | high | xhigh | extreme>` ranges from a very benevolent scan to a very aggressive sweep. |

+ * Project-relative path to the Git attributes initialized by Promptbook Coder.

+export const CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_FILE_PATH = '.gitattributes';
+
+/**
+ * Default Git attributes for automatic text detection and consistent LF line endings.
+ */
+const DEFAULT_CODER_GITATTRIBUTES_CONTENT = '* text=auto eol=lf';

+ * @private function of `initializeCoderProjectConfiguration`

+export async function ensureCoderGitattributesFile(projectPath: string): Promise<InitializationStatus> {

diff --git a/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..f2adc567934c05453e76e15530fd1e8fc02fa44c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { stat, writeFile } from 'fs/promises';
+import { join } from 'path';
+import type { ProjectInitializationStatus } from './projectInitialization';
+
+/**
+ * Creates one project text file with default content, preserving any existing file.
+ *
+ * @private internal utility of Promptbook CLI project initialization
+ */
+export async function ensureProjectTextFile(
+    projectPath: string,
+    relativeFilePath: string,
+    fileContent: string,
+): Promise<ProjectInitializationStatus> {
+    const absoluteFilePath = join(projectPath, relativeFilePath);
+    if (await isExistingFile(absoluteFilePath)) {
+        return 'unchanged';
+    }
+
+    await writeFile(absoluteFilePath, `${fileContent}\n`, 'utf-8');
+    return 'created';
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a path exists and is a file.
+ */
+async function isExistingFile(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
+    try {
+        return (await stat(path)).isFile();
+    } catch {
+        return false;
+    }
+}
+
+// Note: [🟡] Code for project text file bootstrapping [ensureProjectTextFile](src/cli/cli-commands/common/ensureProjectTextFile.ts) should never be published outside of `@promptbook/cli`
